keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Lamin Jawo (Jablonec).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nelson Okeke (Jablonec) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joel Bichsel (Lugano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Jablonec 0, Lugano 0.
Substitution, Jablonec. Antonín Rusek replaces Dominik Holly.
Substitution, Jablonec. Sebastian Nebyla replaces Nelson Okeke.
Delay in match because of an injury Klemen Mihelak (Jablonec).
Substitution, Lugano. Renato Steffen replaces Beckham Castro.
Substitution, Lugano. Daniel Dos Santos replaces Elias Pihlström.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Jablonec 1, Lugano 0. Martin Cedidla (Jablonec) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Lugano. Martim Marques replaces Joel Bichsel.
Substitution, Lugano. Kevin Behrens replaces Albian Ajeti.
Substitution, Lugano. Dereck Moncada replaces Ahmed Kendouci.
Jirí Sláma (Jablonec) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Jablonec 2, Lugano 0. Lamin Jawo (Jablonec) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Jablonec. Filip Novák replaces Martin Cedidla.
Vakhtang Tchanturishvili (Jablonec) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Jablonec. Matej Polidar replaces Saidou Alioum.
Substitution, Jablonec. Daniel Soucek replaces Richard Sedlácek.
